def standardize_gene_symbol(g: str) -> str:
    if g is None:
        return ""
    s = str(g)
    if "." in s:
        head, tail = s.split(".", 1)
        if tail.isdigit():
            s = head
    return s.upper()


def _load_symbol_map() -> Dict[str, str]:
    # Map aliases/synonyms to standardized symbols if available
    symbol_map_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_symbol_map.csv")
    mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if os.path.exists(symbol_map_csv):
        df = pd.read_csv(symbol_map_csv)
        cols = set(df.columns.str.lower())
        # expect columns like 'alias' and 'standardized_symbol'
        if "alias" in cols and "standardized_symbol" in cols:
            alias_col = [c for c in df.columns if c.lower() == "alias"][0]
            std_col = [c for c in df.columns if c.lower() == "standardized_symbol"][0]
            for a, s in zip(df[alias_col], df[std_col]):
                a_std = standardize_gene_symbol(a)
                s_std = standardize_gene_symbol(s)
                if a_std and s_std:
                    mapping[a_std] = s_std
    return mapping


def _apply_symbol_map(s: str, sym_map: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    s_std = standardize_gene_symbol(s)
    return sym_map.get(s_std, s_std)


def compute_degs(adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[Dict[str, List[str]], List[str]]:
    # Align assignments to adata and drop cells without assignments
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    valid_mask_cells = merged["predicted_cluster"].notna()
    if valid_mask_cells.sum() == 0:
        return {}, []
    adata = adata[valid_mask_cells.values].copy()
    clus_series = merged.loc[valid_mask_cells, "predicted_cluster"].astype(int).astype(str)
    # Drop very small clusters
    counts = clus_series.value_counts()
    keep_clusters = counts[counts >= 20].index.tolist()
    keep_mask = clus_series.isin(keep_clusters)
    adata = adata[keep_mask.values].copy()
    clus_series = clus_series[keep_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
    if adata.n_obs == 0 or len(keep_clusters) < 2:
        return {}, []
    adata.obs["predicted_cluster"] = pd.Categorical(clus_series.values)
    # Restrict to modeling universe and protein-coding if present
    mask_use = np.ones(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    if "used_in_model" in adata.var.columns:
        col = adata.var["used_in_model"]
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(col):
            mask_use &= col.values
        elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col):
            mask_use &= (col.values.astype(float) > 0)
        else:
            mask_use &= col.astype(str).str.lower().isin(["true", "1", "yes"]).values
    if "gene_biotype" in adata.var.columns:
        gb = adata.var["gene_biotype"].astype(str).str.lower()
        mask_use &= gb.eq("protein_coding")
    if mask_use.sum() >= 100:
        adata = adata[:, mask_use].copy()

    # Ensure float dtype
    if sparse.issparse(adata.X):
        adata.X = adata.X.astype(np.float32)
    else:
        adata.X = np.asarray(adata.X, dtype=np.float32)

    def fallback_markers(a: ad.AnnData, groupby: str, top_n: int = 10) -> Tuple[Dict[str, List[str]], List[str]]:
        X = a.X
        if sparse.issparse(X):
            X = X.tocsr()
            Xin_linear = X.copy()
            Xin_linear.data = np.expm1(Xin_linear.data)
            X = Xin_linear
        else:
            X = np.asarray(X)
            X = np.expm1(X)
        groups = list(a.obs[groupby].cat.categories.astype(str))
        markers: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        top_global = set()
        for g in groups:
            mask_in = (a.obs[groupby].astype(str) == g).values
            if mask_in.sum() < 10 or (~mask_in).sum() < 10:
                markers[g] = []
                continue
            Xin = X[mask_in]
            Xout = X[~mask_in]
            mean_in = np.asarray(Xin.mean(axis=0)).ravel()
            mean_out = np.asarray(Xout.mean(axis=0)).ravel()
            lfc = np.log2((mean_in + 1e-6) / (mean_out + 1e-6))
            order = np.argsort(-np.abs(lfc))[:top_n]
            genes = a.var_names[order].astype(str).tolist()
            markers[g] = genes
            top_global.update(genes)
        return markers, list(top_global)

    try:
        sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(
            adata,
            groupby="predicted_cluster",
            method="wilcoxon",
            use_raw=False,
            corr_method="benjamini-hochberg",
            tie_correct=True,
            pts=True,
            rankby_abs=True,
        )
        groups = list(adata.obs["predicted_cluster"].cat.categories.astype(str))
        degs: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        top_markers_global = set()
        df_all = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, None)
        # enforce filters: adj p < 0.05, pct_in >= 0.1, pct_out <= 0.1, |log2FC| >= 0.5
        for g in groups:
            df_g = df_all[df_all["group"].astype(str) == g].copy()
            if "pvals_adj" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pvals_adj"].astype(float) < 0.05]
            if "pct_in" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pct_in"].astype(float) >= 0.1]
            if "pct_out" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pct_out"].astype(float) <= 0.1]
            if "logfoldchanges" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g.assign(abs_lfc=lambda x: x["logfoldchanges"].astype(float).abs())
                df_g = df_g[df_g["abs_lfc"] >= 0.5]
                df_g = df_g.sort_values("abs_lfc", ascending=False)
            top_genes = df_g["names"].astype(str).head(10).tolist()
            degs[g] = top_genes
            top_markers_global.update(top_genes)
        return degs, list(top_markers_global)
    except Exception:
        return fallback_markers(adata, "predicted_cluster")


def load_prior_sets() -> Tuple[sparse.csr_matrix, pd.DataFrame, Dict[int, List[int]], pd.DataFrame]:
    genes_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_genes.csv")
    sets_meta_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_sets_metadata.csv")
    mem_npz = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_set_membership.npz")
    assert os.path.exists(genes_csv) and os.path.exists(sets_meta_csv) and os.path.exists(mem_npz), "Missing prior artifacts"
    genes_df = pd.read_csv(genes_csv)
    sets_df = pd.read_csv(sets_meta_csv)
    mem = sparse.load_npz(mem_npz).tocsr()
    assert mem.shape[0] == genes_df.shape[0], "Membership-gene dimension mismatch"
    assert mem.shape[1] == sets_df.shape[0], "Membership-set dimension mismatch"
    # Precompute set -> member gene indices for speed
    set_to_genes: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
    mem_csc = mem.tocsc()
    for s in range(mem_csc.shape[1]):
        start = mem_csc.indptr[s]
        end = mem_csc.indptr[s + 1]
        set_to_genes[s] = mem_csc.indices[start:end].tolist()
    return mem, sets_df, set_to_genes, genes_df


def _bh_fdr(pvals: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    p = np.array(pvals, dtype=float)
    n = len(p)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    order = np.argsort(p)
    ranks = np.empty(n, dtype=int)
    ranks[order] = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    q = p * n / ranks
    # enforce monotonicity
    q_sorted = np.minimum.accumulate(q[order][::-1])[::-1]
    q_adj = np.empty_like(q)
    q_adj[order] = np.clip(q_sorted, 0.0, 1.0)
    return q_adj.tolist()


def enrichment_top_gene_sets(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_markers: Dict[str, List[str]],
    prior_mem: sparse.csr_matrix,
    sets_meta: pd.DataFrame,
    set_to_genes: Dict[int, List[int]],
    prior_genes_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
    # Map adata var genes to prior gene index via standardized symbol with synonym resolution
    sym_map = _load_symbol_map()
    sym_to_idx = {standardize_gene_symbol(s): int(i) for i, s in enumerate(prior_genes_df["standardized_symbol"])}
    adata_syms_std = np.array([_apply_symbol_map(g, sym_map) for g in adata.var_names])
    adata_to_prior_idx = np.array([sym_to_idx.get(s, -1) for s in adata_syms_std], dtype=int)
    # Universe: intersect modeling genes if available
    mask_model = np.ones(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    if "used_in_model" in adata.var.columns:
        col = adata.var["used_in_model"]
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(col):
            mask_model &= col.values
        elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col):
            mask_model &= (col.values.astype(float) > 0)
        else:
            mask_model &= adata.var["used_in_model"].astype(str).str.lower().isin(["true", "1", "yes"]).values
    valid_mask = (adata_to_prior_idx >= 0) & mask_model
    universe_prior_idx = set(adata_to_prior_idx[valid_mask].tolist())
    M = len(universe_prior_idx)
    # Precompute set sizes in universe
    set_sizes_in_univ: Dict[int, int] = {}
    set_over_univ: Dict[int, set] = {}
    for s, gidxs in set_to_genes.items():
        inter = universe_prior_idx.intersection(gidxs)
        set_over_univ[s] = set(inter)
        set_sizes_in_univ[s] = len(inter)
    # Filter sets by size range
    valid_sets = [s for s, sz in set_sizes_in_univ.items() if 10 <= sz <= 500]
    results: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
    for clus, markers in cluster_markers.items():
        marker_syms = [_apply_symbol_map(g, sym_map) for g in markers]
        marker_prior_idx = [sym_to_idx.get(s, -1) for s in marker_syms]
        marker_prior_idx = [i for i in marker_prior_idx if i >= 0 and i in universe_prior_idx]
        n = len(set(marker_prior_idx))
        ranked = []
        if n == 0 or M == 0:
            results[clus] = []
            continue
        pvals = []
        entries = []
        for s in valid_sets:
            K = set_sizes_in_univ[s]
            if K == 0:
                continue
            overlap = len(set_over_univ[s].intersection(marker_prior_idx))
            if overlap == 0:
                continue
            pval = float(hypergeom.sf(overlap - 1, M, K, n))
            entry = {
                "set_id": int(s),
                "name": str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["name"]) if "name" in sets_meta.columns else f"set_{s}",
                "source": str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["source"]) if "source" in sets_meta.columns else "NA",
                "size": int(K),
                "overlap": int(overlap),
                "pval": pval,
            }
            entries.append(entry)
            pvals.append(pval)
        if entries:
            qvals = _bh_fdr(pvals)
            for e, q in zip(entries, qvals):
                e["qval"] = float(q)
            entries.sort(key=lambda x: (x["qval"], -x["overlap"]))
            ranked = entries[:10]
        results[clus] = ranked
    return results


def compute_top_sets_from_zprior(
    adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame, sets_meta: pd.DataFrame
) -> Optional[Dict[str, List[Dict]]]:
    if "z_prior" not in adata.obsm_keys():
        return None
    Zp = np.asarray(adata.obsm["z_prior"])
    # Align to assignments
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    if merged["predicted_cluster"].isna().all():
        return None
    clus = merged["predicted_cluster"].astype(pd.Int64Dtype()).values
    # Compute per-cluster mean activity
    valid = ~pd.isna(clus)
    clus = np.array(clus[valid].astype(int))
    Zp = Zp[valid]
    results: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
    n_sets = Zp.shape[1]
    # If metadata size mismatches, still proceed for names if possible
    for c in np.unique(clus):
        mask = clus == c
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            results[str(int(c))] = []
            continue
        mean_act = Zp[mask].mean(axis=0)
        order = np.argsort(-np.abs(mean_act))[:10]
        lst = []
        for s in order:
            name = str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["name"]) if (s < len(sets_meta)) and ("name" in sets_meta.columns) else f"set_{s}"
            source = str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["source"]) if (s < len(sets_meta)) and ("source" in sets_meta.columns) else "NA"
            lst.append({"set_id": int(s), "name": name, "source": source, "score": float(mean_act[s])})
        results[str(int(c))] = lst
    return results


def compute_batch_proportions(adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]]:
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    fields = [f for f in ["domain", "protocol", "dataset"] if f in merged.columns]
    out: Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]] = {}
    for clus, df_c in merged.groupby("predicted_cluster"):
        clus = str(int(clus))
        out[clus] = {}
        total = float(df_c.shape[0])
        for f in fields:
            counts = df_c[f].astype(str).value_counts(dropna=False)
            props = (counts / total).to_dict() if total > 0 else {}
            out[clus][f] = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in props.items()}
    return out


def write_cluster_summary(
    cluster_sizes: Dict[str, int],
    cluster_markers: Dict[str, List[str]],
    top_sets: Dict[str, List[Dict]],
    batch_props: Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]],
) -> None:
    summary: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    for clus in cluster_sizes.keys():
        clus_str = str(clus)
        top_sets_list = top_sets.get(clus_str, [])
        provisional_label = top_sets_list[0]["name"] if top_sets_list else "NA"
        summary[clus_str] = {
            "size": int(cluster_sizes[clus_str]),
            "top_markers": cluster_markers.get(clus_str, []),
            "top_gene_sets": top_sets_list,
            "batch_proportions": batch_props.get(clus_str, {}),
            "provisional_label": provisional_label,
        }
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    assert os.path.exists(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY), "cluster_summary.json not written"
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY, "r") as f:
        loaded = json.load(f)
    assert isinstance(loaded, dict) and len(loaded) >= 1, "cluster_summary.json malformed"


def main():
    set_seeds(42)
    # 1) Clustering on embedding with sharpened graph and stability-driven selection
    assignments_df, clust_meta = compute_cluster_assignments()
    write_cluster_assignments(assignments_df)

    # 2) Metrics (test-only ARI)
    ari, n_test_used = compute_ari_on_test(assignments_df)
    write_cluster_metrics(ari, n_test_used, extra=clust_meta)

    # 3) DEGs and pathway summaries
    adata_all = load_preprocessed_concat()
    degs_per_cluster, _ = compute_degs(adata_all, assignments_df)
    # Normalize cluster id keys to strings
    degs_per_cluster = {str(k): v for k, v in degs_per_cluster.items()}
    # Cluster sizes
    cluster_sizes = assignments_df["predicted_cluster"].value_counts().sort_index()
    cluster_sizes = {str(int(k)): int(v) for k, v in cluster_sizes.items()}

    # Enrichment against prior sets with FDR and corrected background
    prior_mem, sets_meta, set_to_genes, prior_genes_df = load_prior_sets()
    # Prefer z_prior-based top sets if available; otherwise use DEG overlap enrichment
    zprior_sets = compute_top_sets_from_zprior(adata_all, assignments_df, sets_meta)
    if zprior_sets is not None:
        top_sets = zprior_sets
    else:
        top_sets = enrichment_top_gene_sets(adata_all, degs_per_cluster, prior_mem, sets_meta, set_to_genes, prior_genes_df)

    # Batch proportions
    batch_props = compute_batch_proportions(adata_all, assignments_df)

    # 4) Write summary
    write_cluster_summary(cluster_sizes, degs_per_cluster, top_sets, batch_props)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()</IMPROVED_VARIABLE>

def l2_row_normalize(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    norms = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    norms[norms == 0] = 1.0
    return x / norms


def whiten_dims(x: np.ndarray, eps: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray:
    # center and scale each feature to unit variance
    mu = x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    std = x.std(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    std = np.where(std < eps, 1.0, std)
    return (x - mu) / std


def normalize_embedding_for_graph(emb: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    x = whiten_dims(emb)
    x = l2_row_normalize(x)
    return x


def build_graph_umap_connectivities(emb: np.ndarray, k: int = 30, prune_threshold: float = 0.05) -> ig.Graph:
    # Use UMAP fuzzy simplicial set (Scanpy neighbors) to get locally scaled connectivities
    x = normalize_embedding_for_graph(emb)
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(X=x)
    sc.pp.neighbors(ad_tmp, n_neighbors=int(max(2, min(k, x.shape[0] - 1))), metric="cosine", method="umap")
    W = ad_tmp.obsp["connectivities"].tocsr()
    if prune_threshold > 0.0:
        W = W.tocsr()
        W.data[W.data < prune_threshold] = 0.0
        W.eliminate_zeros()
    # Build igraph from upper triangle of W to avoid duplicates
    W = sparse.triu(W, k=1).tocsr()
    rows, cols = W.nonzero()
    weights = W.data.tolist()
    n = x.shape[0]
    edges = list(zip(rows.tolist(), cols.tolist()))
    g = ig.Graph(n=n, edges=edges, directed=False)
    g.es["weight"] = weights
    g.vs["name"] = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
    return g


def leiden_membership(g: ig.Graph, resolution: float, seed: int = 42) -> List[int]:
    part = leidenalg.find_partition(
        g,
        leidenalg.RBConfigurationVertexPartition,
        weights=g.es["weight"] if g.ecount() > 0 else None,
        resolution_parameter=resolution,
        seed=seed,
        n_iterations=-1,
    )
    membership = part.membership
    return membership


def compute_modularity(g: ig.Graph, membership: List[int]) -> float:
    if g.ecount() == 0:
        return 0.0
    return g.modularity(membership, weights=g.es["weight"])


def _bootstrap_stability_internal(
    label_maps: List[Dict[int, int]]
) -> float:
    if len(label_maps) <= 1:
        return 0.0
    aris = []
    keys_list = [set(m.keys()) for m in label_maps]
    for i in range(len(label_maps)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(label_maps)):
            keys = sorted(keys_list[i] & keys_list[j])
            if len(keys) < 2:
                continue
            li = [label_maps[i][k] for k in keys]
            lj = [label_maps[j][k] for k in keys]
            aris.append(adjusted_rand_score(li, lj))
    return float(np.mean(aris)) if aris else 0.0


def bootstrap_stability(
    g: ig.Graph,
    resolution: float,
    n_boot: int = 5,
    sample_frac: float = 0.8,
    base_seed: int = 42,
    restrict_vertices: Optional[List[int]] = None,
) -> float:
    # If restrict_vertices provided, we sample within that universe
    rng = np.random.RandomState(base_seed)
    if restrict_vertices is None:
        universe = np.arange(g.vcount(), dtype=int)
    else:
        universe = np.array(restrict_vertices, dtype=int)
    n_univ = universe.shape[0]
    if n_univ < 4 or g.ecount() == 0:
        return 0.0
    label_maps: List[Dict[int, int]] = []
    for b in range(n_boot):
        size = max(2, int(sample_frac * n_univ))
        sub_idx_univ = np.sort(rng.choice(universe, size=size, replace=False))
        sub = g.subgraph(sub_idx_univ.tolist())
        sub_part = leidenalg.find_partition(
            sub,
            leidenalg.RBConfigurationVertexPartition,
            weights=sub.es["weight"] if sub.ecount() > 0 else None,
            resolution_parameter=resolution,
            seed=base_seed + b + 1,
            n_iterations=-1,
        )
        labels = sub_part.membership
        # Map back to original graph vertex ids
        label_maps.append({int(sub_idx_univ[i]): int(labels[i]) for i in range(len(labels))})
    return _bootstrap_stability_internal(label_maps)


def relabel_contiguous(labels: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    # Map arbitrary ints to 0..C-1 preserving order of first appearance
    mapping: Dict[int, int] = {}
    next_id = 0
    out = []
    for l in labels:
        if l not in mapping:
            mapping[l] = next_id
            next_id += 1
        out.append(mapping[l])
    return out


def refine_assignments(
    emb: np.ndarray,
    membership: List[int],
    k_reassign: int = 30,
    min_cluster_size: int = 30,
    core_threshold: float = 0.6,
) -> List[int]:
    x = normalize_embedding_for_graph(emb)
    labels = np.array(membership, dtype=int)
    # Merge very small clusters into nearest centroid neighbor
    counts = pd.Series(labels).value_counts().to_dict()
    unique = sorted(set(labels.tolist()))
    centroids = {c: x[labels == c].mean(axis=0) for c in unique}
    for c in unique:
        if counts.get(c, 0) < min_cluster_size:
            # find nearest other centroid
            dists = {c2: np.linalg.norm(centroids[c] - centroids[c2]) for c2 in unique if c2 != c and counts.get(c2, 0) > 0}
            if not dists:
                continue
            target = min(dists, key=dists.get)
            labels[labels == c] = target
    # Recompute uniques
    labels = np.array(relabel_contiguous(labels.tolist()), dtype=int)
    # kNN majority reassignment for ambiguous cells vs cores
    n = x.shape[0]
    k_use = int(max(2, min(k_reassign, n - 1)))
    nbrs = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=k_use + 1, metric="cosine")
    nbrs.fit(x)
    _, knn_idx = nbrs.kneighbors(x, return_distance=True)
    knn_idx = knn_idx[:, 1:]  # drop self
    # core if majority of neighbors share same label
    core_mask = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    for i in range(n):
        neigh_labels = labels[knn_idx[i]]
        frac = (neigh_labels == labels[i]).mean() if knn_idx.shape[1] > 0 else 1.0
        core_mask[i] = frac >= core_threshold
    core_mask = core_mask.astype(bool)
    # Reassign ambiguous cells to the cluster with most core neighbors
    for i in range(n):
        if core_mask[i]:
            continue
        neigh = knn_idx[i]
        core_neigh = neigh[core_mask[neigh]]
        if core_neigh.size == 0:
            continue
        votes = pd.Series(labels[core_neigh]).value_counts()
        best = int(votes.index[0])
        labels[i] = best
    labels = np.array(relabel_contiguous(labels.tolist()), dtype=int)
    return labels.tolist()


def choose_best_params(
    emb: np.ndarray, splits: List[str], k_list: List[int], res_list: List[float], seed: int = 42
) -> Tuple[int, float, List[int], Dict[str, float]]:
    best = {
        "score": -np.inf,
        "k": None,
        "res": None,
        "membership": None,
        "modularity": None,
        "stability_global": None,
        "stability_test": None,
    }
    idx_test = [i for i, s in enumerate(splits) if str(s) == "test"]
    for k in k_list:
        g = build_graph_umap_connectivities(emb, k=k, prune_threshold=0.05)
        for res in res_list:
            mem = leiden_membership(g, res, seed=seed)
            n_clusters = len(set(mem))
            # Compute stability metrics
            stab_g = bootstrap_stability(g, res, n_boot=5, sample_frac=0.8, base_seed=seed, restrict_vertices=None)
            stab_t = bootstrap_stability(
                g, res, n_boot=5, sample_frac=0.8, base_seed=seed + 123, restrict_vertices=idx_test if len(idx_test) >= 10 else None
            )
            # harmonic mean to combine
            if (stab_g + stab_t) > 0:
                score = 2.0 * stab_g * stab_t / (stab_g + stab_t)
            else:
                score = 0.0
            mod = compute_modularity(g, mem)
            # Enforce cluster count constraint
            if not (8 <= n_clusters <= 40):
                score = score * 0.5  # deprioritize
            # Prefer higher score; tiebreak by modularity
            if (score > best["score"]) or (np.isclose(score, best["score"]) and mod > (best["modularity"] or -np.inf)):
                best.update(
                    {
                        "score": float(score),
                        "k": int(k),
                        "res": float(res),
                        "membership": list(map(int, mem)),
                        "modularity": float(mod),
                        "stability_global": float(stab_g),
                        "stability_test": float(stab_t),
                    }
                )
    if best["k"] is None or best["res"] is None or best["membership"] is None:
        raise RuntimeError("No clustering candidates were produced.")
    # Post-process refinement
    refined = refine_assignments(emb, best["membership"], k_reassign=best["k"], min_cluster_size=30, core_threshold=0.6)
    # Recompute modularity on the best graph with refined labels
    g_best = build_graph_umap_connectivities(emb, k=best["k"], prune_threshold=0.05)
    best["modularity"] = float(compute_modularity(g_best, refined))
    return int(best["k"]), float(best["res"]), list(map(int, refined)), {
        "resolution": float(best["res"]),
        "k": int(best["k"]),
        "modularity": float(best["modularity"]),
        "stability_global": float(best["stability_global"]),
        "stability_test": float(best["stability_test"]),
    }


def compute_cluster_assignments() -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, Dict[str, float]]:
    emb, meta = load_embedding_and_meta()
    # Grid search over k and resolution with stability-based selection
    k_grid = [10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50]
    res_grid = [round(r, 1) for r in np.arange(0.1, 1.21, 0.1)]
    k_best, res_best, membership, meta_metrics = choose_best_params(emb, meta["split"].astype(str).tolist(), k_grid, res_grid, seed=42)
    clusters = pd.Series(membership, name="predicted_cluster").astype(int)
    out_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"cell_id": meta["cell_id"].astype(str).values, "predicted_cluster": clusters.values, "split": meta["split"].astype(str).values}
    )
    return out_df, meta_metrics


def write_cluster_assignments(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    df.to_csv(OUT_CLUSTER_ASSIGN, index=False)
    assert os.path.exists(OUT_CLUSTER_ASSIGN), "cluster_assignments.csv not written"
    df2 = pd.read_csv(OUT_CLUSTER_ASSIGN)
    req_cols = ["cell_id", "predicted_cluster", "split"]
    assert all(c in df2.columns for c in req_cols), "cluster_assignments missing required columns"
    assert df2.shape[0] == df.shape[0] and df2.shape[1] >= 3, "cluster_assignments shape mismatch"
    assert pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(df2["predicted_cluster"]), "predicted_cluster must be integer dtype"
    assert pd.api.types.is_object_dtype(df2["split"]) or pd.api.types.is_categorical_dtype(df2["split"]), "split must be string-like"


def compute_ari_on_test(assignments: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[float, int]:
    adata = ad.read_h5ad(INPUT_MOD1)
    if "cell_type" not in adata.obs.columns:
        raise KeyError("cell_type not found in input_mod1 obs for ARI evaluation")
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = assignments.merge(obs[["cell_id", "cell_type"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    test_df = merged[merged["split"] == "test"].dropna(subset=["cell_type"])
    y_true = test_df["cell_type"].astype(str).values
    y_pred = test_df["predicted_cluster"].astype(int).values
    ari = float(adjusted_rand_score(y_true, y_pred))
    return ari, int(test_df.shape[0])


def write_cluster_metrics(ari: float, n_test_used: int, extra: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None) -> None:
    metrics = {"ari": float(ari), "n_test_used": int(n_test_used)}
    if extra:
        metrics.update({k: float(v) for k, v in extra.items()})
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_METRICS, "w") as f:
        json.dump(metrics, f)
    assert os.path.exists(OUT_CLUSTER_METRICS), "cluster_metrics.json not written"
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_METRICS, "r") as f:
        loaded = json.load(f)
    assert "ari" in loaded and isinstance(loaded["ari"], (float, int)), "cluster_metrics.json missing numeric 'ari'"


def load_preprocessed_concat() -> ad.AnnData:
    a_tr = ad.read_h5ad(PREPROCESS_TRAIN)
    a_va = ad.read_h5ad(PREPROCESS_VAL)
    a_te = ad.read_h5ad(PREPROCESS_TEST)
    adata = ad.concat([a_tr, a_va, a_te], axis=0, join="outer", label=None, merge="same")
    if adata.X is None:
        raise ValueError("Preprocessed AnnData has no X matrix")
    return adata


def standardize_gene_symbol(g: str) -> str:
    if g is None:
        return ""
    s = str(g)
    if "." in s:
        head, tail = s.split(".", 1)
        if tail.isdigit():
            s = head
    return s.upper()


def _load_symbol_map() -> Dict[str, str]:
    # Map aliases/synonyms to standardized symbols if available
    symbol_map_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_symbol_map.csv")
    mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if os.path.exists(symbol_map_csv):
        df = pd.read_csv(symbol_map_csv)
        cols = set(df.columns.str.lower())
        # expect columns like 'alias' and 'standardized_symbol'
        if "alias" in cols and "standardized_symbol" in cols:
            alias_col = [c for c in df.columns if c.lower() == "alias"][0]
            std_col = [c for c in df.columns if c.lower() == "standardized_symbol"][0]
            for a, s in zip(df[alias_col], df[std_col]):
                a_std = standardize_gene_symbol(a)
                s_std = standardize_gene_symbol(s)
                if a_std and s_std:
                    mapping[a_std] = s_std
    return mapping


def _apply_symbol_map(s: str, sym_map: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    s_std = standardize_gene_symbol(s)
    return sym_map.get(s_std, s_std)


def compute_degs(adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[Dict[str, List[str]], List[str]]:
    # Align assignments to adata and drop cells without assignments
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    valid_mask_cells = merged["predicted_cluster"].notna()
    if valid_mask_cells.sum() == 0:
        return {}, []
    adata = adata[valid_mask_cells.values].copy()
    clus_series = merged.loc[valid_mask_cells, "predicted_cluster"].astype(int).astype(str)
    # Drop very small clusters
    counts = clus_series.value_counts()
    keep_clusters = counts[counts >= 20].index.tolist()
    keep_mask = clus_series.isin(keep_clusters)
    adata = adata[keep_mask.values].copy()
    clus_series = clus_series[keep_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
    if adata.n_obs == 0 or len(keep_clusters) < 2:
        return {}, []
    adata.obs["predicted_cluster"] = pd.Categorical(clus_series.values)
    # Restrict to modeling universe and protein-coding if present
    mask_use = np.ones(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    if "used_in_model" in adata.var.columns:
        col = adata.var["used_in_model"]
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(col):
            mask_use &= col.values
        elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col):
            mask_use &= (col.values.astype(float) > 0)
        else:
            mask_use &= col.astype(str).str.lower().isin(["true", "1", "yes"]).values
    if "gene_biotype" in adata.var.columns:
        gb = adata.var["gene_biotype"].astype(str).str.lower()
        mask_use &= gb.eq("protein_coding")
    if mask_use.sum() >= 100:
        adata = adata[:, mask_use].copy()

    # Ensure float dtype
    if sparse.issparse(adata.X):
        adata.X = adata.X.astype(np.float32)
    else:
        adata.X = np.asarray(adata.X, dtype=np.float32)

    def fallback_markers(a: ad.AnnData, groupby: str, top_n: int = 10) -> Tuple[Dict[str, List[str]], List[str]]:
        X = a.X
        if sparse.issparse(X):
            X = X.tocsr()
            Xin_linear = X.copy()
            Xin_linear.data = np.expm1(Xin_linear.data)
            X = Xin_linear
        else:
            X = np.asarray(X)
            X = np.expm1(X)
        groups = list(a.obs[groupby].cat.categories.astype(str))
        markers: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        top_global = set()
        for g in groups:
            mask_in = (a.obs[groupby].astype(str) == g).values
            if mask_in.sum() < 10 or (~mask_in).sum() < 10:
                markers[g] = []
                continue
            Xin = X[mask_in]
            Xout = X[~mask_in]
            mean_in = np.asarray(Xin.mean(axis=0)).ravel()
            mean_out = np.asarray(Xout.mean(axis=0)).ravel()
            lfc = np.log2((mean_in + 1e-6) / (mean_out + 1e-6))
            order = np.argsort(-np.abs(lfc))[:top_n]
            genes = a.var_names[order].astype(str).tolist()
            markers[g] = genes
            top_global.update(genes)
        return markers, list(top_global)

    try:
        sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(
            adata,
            groupby="predicted_cluster",
            method="wilcoxon",
            use_raw=False,
            corr_method="benjamini-hochberg",
            tie_correct=True,
            pts=True,
            rankby_abs=True,
        )
        groups = list(adata.obs["predicted_cluster"].cat.categories.astype(str))
        degs: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        top_markers_global = set()
        df_all = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, None)
        # enforce filters: adj p < 0.05, pct_in >= 0.1, pct_out <= 0.1, |log2FC| >= 0.5
        for g in groups:
            df_g = df_all[df_all["group"].astype(str) == g].copy()
            if "pvals_adj" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pvals_adj"].astype(float) < 0.05]
            if "pct_in" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pct_in"].astype(float) >= 0.1]
            if "pct_out" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g[df_g["pct_out"].astype(float) <= 0.1]
            if "logfoldchanges" in df_g.columns:
                df_g = df_g.assign(abs_lfc=lambda x: x["logfoldchanges"].astype(float).abs())
                df_g = df_g[df_g["abs_lfc"] >= 0.5]
                df_g = df_g.sort_values("abs_lfc", ascending=False)
            top_genes = df_g["names"].astype(str).head(10).tolist()
            degs[g] = top_genes
            top_markers_global.update(top_genes)
        return degs, list(top_markers_global)
    except Exception:
        return fallback_markers(adata, "predicted_cluster")


def load_prior_sets() -> Tuple[sparse.csr_matrix, pd.DataFrame, Dict[int, List[int]], pd.DataFrame]:
    genes_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_genes.csv")
    sets_meta_csv = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_sets_metadata.csv")
    mem_npz = os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "prior_gene_set_membership.npz")
    assert os.path.exists(genes_csv) and os.path.exists(sets_meta_csv) and os.path.exists(mem_npz), "Missing prior artifacts"
    genes_df = pd.read_csv(genes_csv)
    sets_df = pd.read_csv(sets_meta_csv)
    mem = sparse.load_npz(mem_npz).tocsr()
    assert mem.shape[0] == genes_df.shape[0], "Membership-gene dimension mismatch"
    assert mem.shape[1] == sets_df.shape[0], "Membership-set dimension mismatch"
    # Precompute set -> member gene indices for speed
    set_to_genes: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
    mem_csc = mem.tocsc()
    for s in range(mem_csc.shape[1]):
        start = mem_csc.indptr[s]
        end = mem_csc.indptr[s + 1]
        set_to_genes[s] = mem_csc.indices[start:end].tolist()
    return mem, sets_df, set_to_genes, genes_df


def _bh_fdr(pvals: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    p = np.array(pvals, dtype=float)
    n = len(p)
    if n == 0:
        return []
    order = np.argsort(p)
    ranks = np.empty(n, dtype=int)
    ranks[order] = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    q = p * n / ranks
    # enforce monotonicity
    q_sorted = np.minimum.accumulate(q[order][::-1])[::-1]
    q_adj = np.empty_like(q)
    q_adj[order] = np.clip(q_sorted, 0.0, 1.0)
    return q_adj.tolist()


def enrichment_top_gene_sets(
    adata: ad.AnnData,
    cluster_markers: Dict[str, List[str]],
    prior_mem: sparse.csr_matrix,
    sets_meta: pd.DataFrame,
    set_to_genes: Dict[int, List[int]],
    prior_genes_df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
    # Map adata var genes to prior gene index via standardized symbol with synonym resolution
    sym_map = _load_symbol_map()
    sym_to_idx = {standardize_gene_symbol(s): int(i) for i, s in enumerate(prior_genes_df["standardized_symbol"])}
    adata_syms_std = np.array([_apply_symbol_map(g, sym_map) for g in adata.var_names])
    adata_to_prior_idx = np.array([sym_to_idx.get(s, -1) for s in adata_syms_std], dtype=int)
    # Universe: intersect modeling genes if available
    mask_model = np.ones(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    if "used_in_model" in adata.var.columns:
        col = adata.var["used_in_model"]
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(col):
            mask_model &= col.values
        elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col):
            mask_model &= (col.values.astype(float) > 0)
        else:
            mask_model &= adata.var["used_in_model"].astype(str).str.lower().isin(["true", "1", "yes"]).values
    valid_mask = (adata_to_prior_idx >= 0) & mask_model
    universe_prior_idx = set(adata_to_prior_idx[valid_mask].tolist())
    M = len(universe_prior_idx)
    # Precompute set sizes in universe
    set_sizes_in_univ: Dict[int, int] = {}
    set_over_univ: Dict[int, set] = {}
    for s, gidxs in set_to_genes.items():
        inter = universe_prior_idx.intersection(gidxs)
        set_over_univ[s] = set(inter)
        set_sizes_in_univ[s] = len(inter)
    # Filter sets by size range
    valid_sets = [s for s, sz in set_sizes_in_univ.items() if 10 <= sz <= 500]
    results: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
    for clus, markers in cluster_markers.items():
        marker_syms = [_apply_symbol_map(g, sym_map) for g in markers]
        marker_prior_idx = [sym_to_idx.get(s, -1) for s in marker_syms]
        marker_prior_idx = [i for i in marker_prior_idx if i >= 0 and i in universe_prior_idx]
        n = len(set(marker_prior_idx))
        ranked = []
        if n == 0 or M == 0:
            results[clus] = []
            continue
        pvals = []
        entries = []
        for s in valid_sets:
            K = set_sizes_in_univ[s]
            if K == 0:
                continue
            overlap = len(set_over_univ[s].intersection(marker_prior_idx))
            if overlap == 0:
                continue
            pval = float(hypergeom.sf(overlap - 1, M, K, n))
            entry = {
                "set_id": int(s),
                "name": str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["name"]) if "name" in sets_meta.columns else f"set_{s}",
                "source": str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["source"]) if "source" in sets_meta.columns else "NA",
                "size": int(K),
                "overlap": int(overlap),
                "pval": pval,
            }
            entries.append(entry)
            pvals.append(pval)
        if entries:
            qvals = _bh_fdr(pvals)
            for e, q in zip(entries, qvals):
                e["qval"] = float(q)
            entries.sort(key=lambda x: (x["qval"], -x["overlap"]))
            ranked = entries[:10]
        results[clus] = ranked
    return results


def compute_top_sets_from_zprior(
    adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame, sets_meta: pd.DataFrame
) -> Optional[Dict[str, List[Dict]]]:
    if "z_prior" not in adata.obsm_keys():
        return None
    Zp = np.asarray(adata.obsm["z_prior"])
    # Align to assignments
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    if merged["predicted_cluster"].isna().all():
        return None
    clus = merged["predicted_cluster"].astype(pd.Int64Dtype()).values
    # Compute per-cluster mean activity
    valid = ~pd.isna(clus)
    clus = np.array(clus[valid].astype(int))
    Zp = Zp[valid]
    results: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
    n_sets = Zp.shape[1]
    # If metadata size mismatches, still proceed for names if possible
    for c in np.unique(clus):
        mask = clus == c
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            results[str(int(c))] = []
            continue
        mean_act = Zp[mask].mean(axis=0)
        order = np.argsort(-np.abs(mean_act))[:10]
        lst = []
        for s in order:
            name = str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["name"]) if (s < len(sets_meta)) and ("name" in sets_meta.columns) else f"set_{s}"
            source = str(sets_meta.iloc[s]["source"]) if (s < len(sets_meta)) and ("source" in sets_meta.columns) else "NA"
            lst.append({"set_id": int(s), "name": name, "source": source, "score": float(mean_act[s])})
        results[str(int(c))] = lst
    return results


def compute_batch_proportions(adata: ad.AnnData, assignments: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]]:
    obs = adata.obs.copy()
    obs["cell_id"] = obs.index.astype(str)
    merged = obs.merge(assignments[["cell_id", "predicted_cluster"]], on="cell_id", how="left")
    fields = [f for f in ["domain", "protocol", "dataset"] if f in merged.columns]
    out: Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]] = {}
    for clus, df_c in merged.groupby("predicted_cluster"):
        clus = str(int(clus))
        out[clus] = {}
        total = float(df_c.shape[0])
        for f in fields:
            counts = df_c[f].astype(str).value_counts(dropna=False)
            props = (counts / total).to_dict() if total > 0 else {}
            out[clus][f] = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in props.items()}
    return out


def write_cluster_summary(
    cluster_sizes: Dict[str, int],
    cluster_markers: Dict[str, List[str]],
    top_sets: Dict[str, List[Dict]],
    batch_props: Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]],
) -> None:
    summary: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    for clus in cluster_sizes.keys():
        clus_str = str(clus)
        top_sets_list = top_sets.get(clus_str, [])
        provisional_label = top_sets_list[0]["name"] if top_sets_list else "NA"
        summary[clus_str] = {
            "size": int(cluster_sizes[clus_str]),
            "top_markers": cluster_markers.get(clus_str, []),
            "top_gene_sets": top_sets_list,
            "batch_proportions": batch_props.get(clus_str, {}),
            "provisional_label": provisional_label,
        }
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    assert os.path.exists(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY), "cluster_summary.json not written"
    with open(OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY, "r") as f:
        loaded = json.load(f)
    assert isinstance(loaded, dict) and len(loaded) >= 1, "cluster_summary.json malformed"


def main():
    set_seeds(42)
    # 1) Clustering on embedding with sharpened graph and stability-driven selection
    assignments_df, clust_meta = compute_cluster_assignments()
    write_cluster_assignments(assignments_df)

    # 2) Metrics (test-only ARI)
    ari, n_test_used = compute_ari_on_test(assignments_df)
    write_cluster_metrics(ari, n_test_used, extra=clust_meta)

    # 3) DEGs and pathway summaries
    adata_all = load_preprocessed_concat()
    degs_per_cluster, _ = compute_degs(adata_all, assignments_df)
    # Normalize cluster id keys to strings
    degs_per_cluster = {str(k): v for k, v in degs_per_cluster.items()}
    # Cluster sizes
    cluster_sizes = assignments_df["predicted_cluster"].value_counts().sort_index()
    cluster_sizes = {str(int(k)): int(v) for k, v in cluster_sizes.items()}

    # Enrichment against prior sets with FDR and corrected background
    prior_mem, sets_meta, set_to_genes, prior_genes_df = load_prior_sets()
    # Prefer z_prior-based top sets if available; otherwise use DEG overlap enrichment
    zprior_sets = compute_top_sets_from_zprior(adata_all, assignments_df, sets_meta)
    if zprior_sets is not None:
        top_sets = zprior_sets
    else:
        top_sets = enrichment_top_gene_sets(adata_all, degs_per_cluster, prior_mem, sets_meta, set_to_genes, prior_genes_df)

    # Batch proportions
    batch_props = compute_batch_proportions(adata_all, assignments_df)

    # 4) Write summary
    write_cluster_summary(cluster_sizes, degs_per_cluster, top_sets, batch_props)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def standardize_symbol(symbol: str) -> str:

    s = str(symbol)

def compute_cell_qc(adata: ad.AnnData):
    if "nCount_RNA" not in adata.obs.columns or "nFeature_RNA" not in adata.obs.columns:
        sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, inplace=True)
        if "total_counts" in adata.obs.columns:
            adata.obs["nCount_RNA"] = adata.obs["total_counts"].astype(np.int64)
        else:
            X = adata.X
            tot = np.array(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            adata.obs["nCount_RNA"] = tot.astype(np.int64)
        if "n_genes_by_counts" in adata.obs.columns:
            adata.obs["nFeature_RNA"] = adata.obs["n_genes_by_counts"].astype(np.int64)
        else:
            X = adata.X
            if sp.issparse(X):
                ng = np.array((X > 0).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            else:
                ng = (X > 0).sum(axis=1)
            adata.obs["nFeature_RNA"] = ng.astype(np.int64)
    # percent.mt using standardized var names
    if "percent.mt" not in adata.obs.columns:
        var_names_std = adata.var_names.str.upper()
        adata.var["mt"] = np.asarray(var_names_std.str.startswith("MT-"))
        sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, qc_vars=["mt"], inplace=True)
        if "pct_counts_mt" in adata.obs.columns:
            adata.obs["percent.mt"] = adata.obs["pct_counts_mt"]
        else:
            X = adata.X
            if sp.issparse(X):
                mt_counts = np.array(X[:, adata.var["mt"].values].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
                total_counts = np.array(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            else:
                mt_counts = X[:, adata.var["mt"].values].sum(axis=1)
                total_counts = X.sum(axis=1)
            pct = np.zeros_like(total_counts, dtype=np.float64)
            nonzero = total_counts > 0
            pct[nonzero] = (mt_counts[nonzero] / total_counts[nonzero]) * 100.0
            adata.obs["percent.mt"] = pct

def batch_aware_filter_cells(adata: ad.AnnData) -> Tuple[ad.AnnData, Dict]:
    # Robust, batch-aware trimming by dataset||protocol
    qc = {"per_group": {}}
    key = (adata.obs.get("dataset", pd.Series(["unknown"] * adata.n_obs, index=adata.obs_names)).astype(str) + "||" +
           adata.obs.get("protocol", pd.Series(["unknown"] * adata.n_obs, index=adata.obs_names)).astype(str))
    groups = key.values
    keep_mask = np.ones(adata.n_obs, dtype=bool)
    df = adata.obs.copy()
    df["_grp"] = groups
    n0 = adata.n_obs
    for g, idx in df.groupby("_grp").indices.items():
        idx = np.asarray(idx, dtype=np.int64)
        sub = adata.obs.iloc[idx]
        nfeat = sub["nFeature_RNA"].values
        ncount = sub["nCount_RNA"].values.astype(float)
        pmt = sub["percent.mt"].values.astype(float)

        # Feature thresholds (global reasonable bounds retained)
        low_feat = nfeat < 200
        high_feat = nfeat > 7000

        # Counts thresholds (within-group)
        q1 = np.quantile(ncount, 0.01) if len(ncount) > 10 else np.min(ncount)
        q99 = np.quantile(ncount, 0.99) if len(ncount) > 10 else np.max(ncount)
        low_cnt = ncount < q1
        high_cnt = ncount > q99

        # Percent MT robust cutoff per group: median + 3*MAD or 95th percentile
        med = np.median(pmt)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(pmt - med)) + 1e-9
        thr_mad = med + 3.0 * mad
        thr_q95 = np.quantile(pmt, 0.95) if len(pmt) > 10 else med + 3.0 * mad
        thr = max(20.0, min(thr_mad, thr_q95))  # never below the conventional 20%
        high_mt = pmt > thr

        rem = low_feat | high_feat | low_cnt | high_cnt | high_mt
        keep_mask[idx] &= ~rem

        qc["per_group"][g] = {
            "removed_low_features": int(low_feat.sum()),
            "removed_high_features": int(high_feat.sum()),
            "removed_low_counts": int(low_cnt.sum()),
            "removed_high_counts": int(high_cnt.sum()),
            "removed_high_mt": int(high_mt.sum()),
            "n_group": int(len(idx)),
            "kept_group": int((~rem).sum())
        }

    adata = adata[keep_mask].copy()
    qc["removed_total_unique"] = int((~keep_mask).sum())
    qc["remaining_cells"] = int(adata.n_obs)
    qc["removed_fraction"] = float(qc["removed_total_unique"] / n0) if n0 > 0 else 0.0
    return adata, qc

def load_priors(prior_dir: str):
    # prior_genes.csv
    pg = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_genes.csv"))
    sym_col = "standardized_symbol" if "standardized_symbol" in pg.columns else pg.columns[0]
    pg["standardized_symbol"] = pg[sym_col].astype(str).apply(standardize_symbol)
    if "is_mt" not in pg.columns:
        pg["is_mt"] = pg["standardized_symbol"].str.startswith("MT-")
    if "is_ribo" not in pg.columns:
        pg["is_ribo"] = pg["standardized_symbol"].str.startswith("RPS") | pg["standardized_symbol"].str.startswith("RPL")

    # prior gene-symbol map
    symmap_path = os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_gene_symbol_map.csv")
    sym_map_df = None
    if os.path.exists(symmap_path):
        sym_map_df = pd.read_csv(symmap_path)

    # membership
    from scipy.sparse import load_npz
    M = load_npz(os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_gene_set_membership.npz")).tocsr()

    # sets metadata
    gs_meta = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_gene_sets_metadata.csv"))
    if "type" not in gs_meta.columns:
        gs_meta["type"] = "unknown"
    if "source" not in gs_meta.columns:
        gs_meta["source"] = "unknown"
    if "size_in_data" not in gs_meta.columns:
        gs_meta["size_in_data"] = np.array((M > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()

    # Laplacian
    L = load_npz(os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_regulatory_laplacian.npz")).tocsr()

    # set weights (unused here, but validated)
    weights_path = os.path.join(prior_dir, "prior_set_weights.json")
    set_weights = {}
    if os.path.exists(weights_path):
        with open(weights_path, "r") as f:
            set_weights = json.load(f)

    return pg, sym_map_df, M, gs_meta, L, set_weights

def build_symbol_synonym_map(sym_map_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, str]:
    # Flexible ingestion: find columns for original and standardized mapping
    if sym_map_df is None or sym_map_df.empty:
        return {}
    cols = [c.lower() for c in sym_map_df.columns]
    df = sym_map_df.copy()
    df_cols_map = {c.lower(): c for c in df.columns}
    std_col = None
    for k in ["standardized_symbol", "to", "mapped_symbol", "target_symbol", "standard"]:
        if k in cols:
            std_col = df_cols_map[k]
            break
    if std_col is None:
        return {}
    orig_col = None
    for k in ["original_symbol", "from", "dataset_symbol", "source_symbol", "symbol"]:
        if k in cols and k != std_col.lower():
            orig_col = df_cols_map[k]
            break
    if orig_col is None:
        # If only standardized provided, nothing to map
        return {}
    mp = {}
    for _, r in df[[orig_col, std_col]].dropna().iterrows():
        o = standardize_symbol(r[orig_col])
        s = standardize_symbol(r[std_col])
        if o:
            mp[o] = s
    return mp

def collapse_duplicate_symbols(adata: ad.AnnData, symbol_map: Dict[str, str]) -> Tuple[ad.AnnData, Dict]:
    # Map each original var_name to a standardized symbol via symbol_map, else standardize directly
    orig_symbols = [str(g) for g in adata.var_names.tolist()]
    std_symbols = []
    mapped = 0
    for g in orig_symbols:
        s0 = standardize_symbol(g)
        if s0 in symbol_map:
            std_symbols.append(symbol_map[s0])
            mapped += 1
        else:
            std_symbols.append(s0)
    std_symbols = [standardize_symbol(s) for s in std_symbols]

    # Determine ordered unique standardized symbols and mapping to new indices
    df_map = pd.DataFrame({"orig": orig_symbols, "std": std_symbols})
    new_syms = pd.unique(df_map["std"])
    new_sym_to_idx = {s: j for j, s in enumerate(new_syms)}

    # Build sparse selection/aggregation matrix S in CSC format: (n_old x n_new)
    n_old = adata.n_vars
    row_idx = np.arange(n_old, dtype=np.int64)
    col_idx = np.array([new_sym_to_idx[s] for s in std_symbols], dtype=np.int64)
    data = np.ones(n_old, dtype=np.float32)
    S = sp.csc_matrix((data, (row_idx, col_idx)), shape=(n_old, len(new_syms)))

    # Compute new matrix by aggregating columns with the same standardized symbol
    X = adata.X
    if sp.issparse(X):
        X_new = X @ S
        X_new = X_new.tocsr()
    else:
        X_new = np.asarray(X) @ S.toarray()

    # Construct new AnnData with aggregated genes
    ad_new = ad.AnnData(X=X_new, obs=adata.obs.copy(), var=pd.DataFrame(index=new_syms))
    ad_new.var_names = pd.Index(new_syms, name="standardized_symbol")

    # Report
    vc = pd.Series(std_symbols).value_counts()
    collapsed = int((vc > 1).sum())
    dropped = 0
    report = {
        "n_original_genes": int(len(orig_symbols)),
        "n_unique_standardized": int(len(new_syms)),
        "n_mapped_via_synonyms": int(mapped),
        "n_collapsed_symbols": int(collapsed),
        "n_dropped": int(dropped)
    }
    return ad_new, report

def select_sets_within_limits(M_sub: sp.csr_matrix, gs_meta: pd.DataFrame, min_size: int = SET_MIN_SIZE, max_keep: int = SET_MAX_KEEP) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, pd.DataFrame]:
    sizes_after = np.array((M_sub > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    keep_sz = sizes_after >= min_size
    kept_idx = np.where(keep_sz)[0]
    meta_kept = gs_meta.iloc[kept_idx].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    if len(kept_idx) > max_keep:
        type_weight = meta_kept["type"].astype(str).str.lower().map({"marker": 3, "msigdb": 2, "go": 1}).fillna(0).astype(int)
        source_weight = meta_kept["source"].astype(str).str.lower().map({"marker": 3, "msigdb": 2, "go": 1}).fillna(0).astype(int)
        priority = (type_weight * 2 + source_weight).values.astype(float)
        sid = meta_kept["size_in_data"].fillna(0).astype(float).values if "size_in_data" in meta_kept.columns else sizes_after[kept_idx].astype(float)
        sort_idx = np.lexsort((-sid, -priority))
        top = sort_idx[:max_keep]
        kept_idx = kept_idx[top]
        meta_kept = meta_kept.iloc[top].reset_index(drop=True)
    return kept_idx, meta_kept

def deterministic_one_hot(obs: pd.DataFrame, cols: List[str]) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, List[str], Dict[str, List[str]]]:
    df = obs.copy()
    cat_orders = {}
    for c in cols:
        if c not in df.columns:
            df[c] = "unknown"
        vals = df[c].astype(str).replace({"nan": "unknown", "None": "unknown", "": "unknown"})
        cats = sorted(pd.unique(vals))
        df[c] = pd.Categorical(vals, categories=cats, ordered=True)
        cat_orders[c] = cats
    # Build dummies deterministically and cast to float32 (robust to pandas versions)
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(df[cols], prefix=cols)
    dummies = dummies.astype(np.float32)
    return dummies.values.astype(np.float32), list(dummies.columns), cat_orders

def stratified_split_by_keys_min(keys: pd.Series, sizes=(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), seed=RANDOM_STATE) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, Dict]:
    assert abs(sum(sizes) - 1.0) < 1e-6
    rs = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = [], [], []
    info = {"groups": {}}
    g = keys.groupby(keys, sort=False)
    for grp, idxs in g.indices.items():
        idx = np.asarray(idxs, dtype=np.int64)
        rs.shuffle(idx)
        n = len(idx)
        n_tr = int(np.floor(sizes[0] * n))
        n_val = int(np.floor(sizes[1] * n))
        n_te = n - n_tr - n_val
        # Enforce minimums when possible
        if n >= 3:
            n_val = max(1, n_val)
            n_te = max(1, n - n_tr - n_val)
            if n_tr <= 0:
                n_tr = max(1, n - (n_val + n_te))
        elif n == 2:
            n_val = 1
            n_tr = 1
            n_te = 0
        else:
            n_tr = 1
            n_val = 0
            n_te = 0
        # Adjust to sum n
        while n_tr + n_val + n_te > n:
            if n_tr > 1:
                n_tr -= 1
            elif n_val > 0:
                n_val -= 1
            elif n_te > 0:
                n_te -= 1
            else:
                break
        while n_tr + n_val + n_te < n:
            n_tr += 1
        train_idx.extend(idx[:n_tr])
        val_idx.extend(idx[n_tr:n_tr + n_val])
        test_idx.extend(idx[n_tr + n_val:])
        info["groups"][str(grp)] = {"n": int(n), "train": int(n_tr), "val": int(n_val), "test": int(n_te)}
    return np.array(train_idx, dtype=np.int64), np.array(val_idx, dtype=np.int64), np.array(test_idx, dtype=np.int64), info

def sha1_of_list(lst: List[str]) -> str:
    s = ",".join(lst).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha1(s).hexdigest()

def _safe_ari(y_true, y_pred):
    try:
        from sklearn.metrics import adjusted_rand_score
        return float(adjusted_rand_score(y_true, y_pred))
    except Exception:
        return float("nan")

def _fallback_kmeans(X, k, seed=RANDOM_STATE, max_iter=50):
    rs = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n, d = X.shape
    # init random unique points
    idx = rs.choice(n, size=min(k, n), replace=False)
    cent = X[idx].copy()
    labels = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        # assign
        d2 = ((X[:, None, :] - cent[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2)
        new_labels = d2.argmin(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
        if np.array_equal(new_labels, labels):
            break
        labels = new_labels
        # update
        for j in range(cent.shape[0]):
            mask = labels == j
            if mask.any():
                cent[j] = X[mask].mean(axis=0)
            else:
                # reinit empty cluster
                cent[j] = X[rs.choice(n)]
    return labels

def _kmeans_labels(X, k, seed=RANDOM_STATE):
    try:
        from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
        km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10, random_state=seed)
        return km.fit_predict(X)
    except Exception:
        return _fallback_kmeans(X, k, seed=seed)

def _pca_svd(Y, n_components=50):
    # center columns
    Y = np.asarray(Y, dtype=np.float32)
    col_mean = Y.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    Yc = Y - col_mean
    n_components = int(max(2, min(n_components, Yc.shape[0] - 1, Yc.shape[1])))
    if n_components <= 0:
        return np.zeros((Y.shape[0], 2), dtype=np.float32)
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Yc, full_matrices=False)
    PCs = (U[:, :n_components] * S[:n_components]).astype(np.float32)
    return PCs

def robust_hvg(adata: ad.AnnData, n_top: int) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    hvgs = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    nbatches = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=int)
    # Try seurat_v3 with batch_key
    try:
        sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor="seurat_v3", n_top_genes=n_top, batch_key="dataset", inplace=True)
    except Exception:
        # Try seurat_v3 without batch_key
        try:
            sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor="seurat_v3", n_top_genes=n_top, inplace=True)
        except Exception:
            # Try cell_ranger without batch_key
            try:
                sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor="cell_ranger", n_top_genes=n_top, inplace=True)
            except Exception:
                # Try legacy seurat
                try:
                    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor="seurat", n_top_genes=n_top, inplace=True)
                except Exception:
                    # Final fallback: variance ranking
                    Xd = adata.X.toarray() if sp.issparse(adata.X) else np.asarray(adata.X)
                    var = Xd.var(axis=0)
                    top_idx = np.argsort(var)[-int(min(n_top, adata.n_vars)):]
                    hvgs[top_idx] = True
                    adata.var["highly_variable"] = hvgs
                    adata.var["highly_variable_nbatches"] = nbatches
                    return hvgs, nbatches
    hvgs = adata.var["highly_variable"].astype(bool).values if "highly_variable" in adata.var.columns else hvgs
    if "highly_variable_nbatches" in adata.var.columns:
        try:
            nbatches = adata.var["highly_variable_nbatches"].fillna(0).astype(int).values
        except Exception:
            nbatches = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=int)
    else:
        nbatches = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=int)
    return hvgs, nbatches

def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
    for p in [
        OUT_PREPROCESS_METADATA, OUT_ALL, OUT_TRAIN, OUT_VAL, OUT_TEST,
        OUT_M_FINAL, OUT_L_MODEL, OUT_GS_META_FILTERED, OUT_MODEL_PERF,
        OUT_BEST_MODEL, OUT_EMBED_NPY, OUT_EMBED_META, OUT_TRAINING_LOGS,
        OUT_PIPELINE_SUMMARY, OUT_CLUSTER_ASSIGN, OUT_CLUSTER_METRICS,
        OUT_CLUSTER_SUMMARY
    ]:
        ensure_dir(p)

    # Load priors and synonym map
    pg, sym_map_df, M_full, gs_meta_full, L_full, set_weights = load_priors(PRIOR_DIR)
    prior_symbol_to_idx: Dict[str, int] = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(pg["standardized_symbol"].tolist())}
    synonym_map = build_symbol_synonym_map(sym_map_df)

    # Load data (raw counts)
    adata_raw = sc.read_h5ad(INPUT_MOD1)

    # Keep obs fields
    keep_obs_cols = ["domain", "protocol", "dataset", "cell_type"]
    for col in keep_obs_cols:
        if col not in adata_raw.obs.columns:
            adata_raw.obs[col] = "unknown"
    adata_raw.obs = adata_raw.obs[keep_obs_cols].copy()
    adata_raw.obs["cell_id"] = adata_raw.obs_names.astype(str)

    # Deduplicate/standardize symbols on raw counts BEFORE QC/normalization
    ad_collapsed, collapse_report = collapse_duplicate_symbols(adata_raw, synonym_map)
    # Make var_names canonical and explicit standardized
    ad_collapsed.var_names = pd.Index([standardize_symbol(x) for x in ad_collapsed.var_names.tolist()], name="standardized_symbol")

    # Compute cell QC on collapsed counts
    compute_cell_qc(ad_collapsed)
    # Batch-aware trimming
    ad_collapsed, qc_report = batch_aware_filter_cells(ad_collapsed)

    # Tag mitochondrial/ribosomal (preliminary)
    var_names_std = ad_collapsed.var_names.str.upper()
    ad_collapsed.var["is_mt"] = np.asarray(var_names_std.str.startswith("MT-"))
    ad_collapsed.var["is_ribo"] = np.asarray(var_names_std.str.startswith("RPS") | var_names_std.str.startswith("RPL"))

    # Align to prior: keep only genes present in prior, ensure 1:1 mapping
    std_syms = ad_collapsed.var_names.tolist()
    matched_prior_idx = []
    matched_dataset_idx = []
    for j, sym in enumerate(std_syms):
        pidx = prior_symbol_to_idx.get(sym, None)
        if pidx is not None:
            matched_prior_idx.append(pidx)
            matched_dataset_idx.append(j)
    if len(matched_dataset_idx) == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("No genes matched between dataset and prior gene list after standardization/synonym resolution.")

    # order by prior index
    order = np.argsort(np.array(matched_prior_idx))
    matched_prior_idx_sorted = list(np.array(matched_prior_idx)[order])
    matched_dataset_idx_sorted = list(np.array(matched_dataset_idx)[order])
    # subset/reorder
    adata = ad_collapsed[:, matched_dataset_idx_sorted].copy()
    adata.var["prior_index"] = matched_prior_idx_sorted
    # Re-assert 1:1
    assert len(set(adata.var["prior_index"].tolist())) == adata.n_vars, "Duplicated prior_index detected after collapsing; 1:1 alignment required."

    # authoritative flags from prior
    prior_flags = pg.iloc[matched_prior_idx_sorted][["is_mt", "is_ribo"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    adata.var["is_mt"] = prior_flags["is_mt"].astype(bool).values
    adata.var["is_ribo"] = prior_flags["is_ribo"].astype(bool).values

    # Save raw counts as int32 CSR
    X_counts = adata.X
    if sp.issparse(X_counts):
        X_counts = X_counts.tocsr()
    else:
        X_counts = sp.csr_matrix(X_counts)
    X_counts = X_counts.astype(np.int32)
    adata.layers["counts"] = X_counts

    # Pre-normalization covariate: log library size
    libsize = np.array(adata.layers["counts"].sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    adata.obs["log_library_size"] = np.log1p(libsize).astype(np.float32)

    # Normalize total to 10k and log1p, keep X float32
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=TARGET_SUM, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    if sp.issparse(adata.X):
        adata.X = adata.X.asfptype().tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    else:
        adata.X = adata.X.astype(np.float32)

    # HVG selection with robust fallbacks (avoids hard dependency on skmisc/loess)
    hvgs, hvg_nbatches = robust_hvg(adata, HVG_TOP_N)

    # Align membership matrix and Laplacian to matched genes (current order)
    M_matched = M_full[matched_prior_idx_sorted, :].tocsr()
    L_matched = L_full[matched_prior_idx_sorted, :][:, matched_prior_idx_sorted].tocsr()

    # Determine genes covered by any prior set
    gene_in_prior = np.array(M_matched.getnnz(axis=1)).ravel() > 0

    # Post-alignment detection filtering: exempt prior-covered genes
    Xbin = adata.layers["counts"]
    if sp.issparse(Xbin):
        detected = np.array((Xbin > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    else:
        detected = (Xbin > 0).sum(axis=0)
    frac = detected / float(adata.n_obs if adata.n_obs > 0 else 1)
    keep_det = (gene_in_prior & (frac >= PRIOR_GENE_MIN_DET_FRAC)) | (~gene_in_prior & (frac >= 0.005))
    # Always keep prior-covered genes even if very rare (exempt), but ensure at least appear in data
    keep_det = keep_det | gene_in_prior
    # Apply detection filter
    det_removed = int((~keep_det).sum())
    adata = adata[:, keep_det].copy()
    M_matched = M_matched[keep_det, :].tocsr()
    L_matched = L_matched[keep_det, :][:, keep_det].tocsr()
    hvgs = hvgs[keep_det]
    hvg_nbatches = hvg_nbatches[keep_det]
    gene_in_prior = gene_in_prior[keep_det]

    # Exclude MT/RPS/RPL from modeling but keep for QC summaries
    exclude = (adata.var["is_mt"].values | adata.var["is_ribo"].values)
    # Initial candidate pool
    used_in_model = (hvgs | gene_in_prior) & (~exclude)

    # Cap to MODEL_GENE_CAP with per-set coverage guarantee and batch-robust prioritization
    if int(used_in_model.sum()) > MODEL_GENE_CAP:
        idx_all = np.arange(adata.n_vars)
        cand = idx_all[used_in_model]
        prior_set_counts = np.array(M_matched.getnnz(axis=1)).ravel()[cand]
        mean_expr = np.array(adata.X.mean(axis=0)).ravel()[cand]
        nbatch = hvg_nbatches[cand]
        # Start by guaranteeing MIN_PER_SET_COVERAGE per set (where possible)
        chosen = set()
        if M_matched.shape[1] > 0:
            gene_sets_cols = range(M_matched.shape[1])
            pri_key = np.lexsort((-mean_expr, -prior_set_counts, -nbatch))
            ranked_cand = cand[pri_key]
            # Precompute per-gene set membership
            M_bool = (M_matched > 0).astype(np.int8)
            for s in gene_sets_cols:
                if M_bool.shape[0] == 0:
                    continue
                in_set = np.array(M_bool[:, s].A).ravel() if sp.issparse(M_bool) else M_bool[:, s].astype(int)
                in_set_idx = cand[in_set[cand] > 0] if in_set.shape[0] == adata.n_vars else np.array([], dtype=int)
                if len(in_set_idx) == 0:
                    continue
                picks = [g for g in ranked_cand if g in in_set_idx]
                for g in picks[:MIN_PER_SET_COVERAGE]:
                    chosen.add(int(g))
                if len(chosen) >= MODEL_GENE_CAP:
                    break
        # Fill remaining budget by prioritizing batch robustness and prior support
        remain_budget = MODEL_GENE_CAP - len(chosen)
        if remain_budget > 0:
            hvg_flag = hvgs[cand].astype(int)
            sort_keys = np.lexsort((-mean_expr, -prior_set_counts, -nbatch, -hvg_flag))
            fill = [int(g) for g in cand[sort_keys] if int(g) not in chosen][:remain_budget]
            chosen.update(fill)
        new_mask = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
        new_mask[list(chosen)] = True
        used_in_model = new_mask

    # Ensure no MT/RPS/RPL included
    assert not np.any(used_in_model & exclude), "MT/RPS/RPL genes should not be used in model."

    adata.var["used_in_model"] = used_in_model

    # Update membership for used genes and compute non-empty set counts before size filtering
    M_used = M_matched[used_in_model, :].tocsr()
    sets_nonempty_before = int(np.array((M_used > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(bool).sum())

    # Drop small sets and downselect if too many
    kept_sets_idx, gs_meta_kept = select_sets_within_limits(M_used, gs_meta_full, min_size=SET_MIN_SIZE, max_keep=SET_MAX_KEEP)
    M_final = M_used[:, kept_sets_idx].tocsr()

    # Build covariates (domain, protocol, dataset) with deterministic encoding + optional libsize
    cov_cols = ["domain", "protocol", "dataset"]
    cov_mat, cov_names, cov_category_orders = deterministic_one_hot(adata.obs, cov_cols)
    # Append log_library_size
    cov_mat = np.concatenate([cov_mat, adata.obs["log_library_size"].values.reshape(-1, 1).astype(np.float32)], axis=1)
    cov_names = cov_names + ["log_library_size"]
    adata.obsm["covariates"] = cov_mat.astype(np.float32)
    adata.uns["covariate_columns"] = cov_names

    # Stratified split by dataset+protocol with minimums
    split_keys = (adata.obs.get("dataset", pd.Series(["unknown"] * adata.n_obs, index=adata.obs_names)).astype(str) + "||" +
                  adata.obs.get("protocol", pd.Series(["unknown"] * adata.n_obs, index=adata.obs_names)).astype(str))
    tr_idx, va_idx, te_idx, split_info = stratified_split_by_keys_min(split_keys, sizes=(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), seed=RANDOM_STATE)
    split_arr = np.array(["train"] * adata.n_obs, dtype=object)
    split_arr[va_idx] = "val"
    split_arr[te_idx] = "test"
    adata.obs["split"] = pd.Categorical(split_arr, categories=["train", "val", "test"])

    # Drop zero-sum-in-train genes from model features
    train_mask_cells = (adata.obs["split"].values == "train")
    train_counts = adata.layers["counts"][train_mask_cells, :]
    if sp.issparse(train_counts):
        gsum_train = np.array(train_counts.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    else:
        gsum_train = np.asarray(train_counts).sum(axis=0).ravel()
    model_gene_initial = np.where(adata.var["used_in_model"].values)[0]
    nonzero_train_mask = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
    nonzero_train_mask[model_gene_initial] = gsum_train[model_gene_initial] > 0
    # Update used_in_model to drop zero-train genes
    used_in_model_final = adata.var["used_in_model"].values & nonzero_train_mask
    adata.var["used_in_model"] = used_in_model_final
    model_gene_indices = np.where(used_in_model_final)[0].tolist()

    # Subset M_final and Laplacian to final model genes and save artifacts
    M_model = M_matched[used_in_model_final, :][:, kept_sets_idx].tocsr()
    # Ensure no empty sets remain after final model gene filtering
    set_sizes_after_model = np.array((M_model > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    valid_sets_mask = set_sizes_after_model >= SET_MIN_SIZE
    if valid_sets_mask.sum() < len(valid_sets_mask):
        # Filter sets again if any got emptied by zero-train drop
        kept_sets_idx = np.array(kept_sets_idx)[valid_sets_mask].tolist()
        gs_meta_kept = gs_meta_kept.loc[valid_sets_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
        M_model = M_model[:, valid_sets_mask].tocsr()
    L_model = L_matched[used_in_model_final, :][:, used_in_model_final].tocsr()

    # Persist reindexed prior artifacts
    scipy.sparse.save_npz(OUT_M_FINAL, M_model.tocsr())
    scipy.sparse.save_npz(OUT_L_MODEL, L_model.tocsr())
    gs_meta_kept.to_csv(OUT_GS_META_FILTERED, index=False)

    # Build final AnnData with only model genes for all cells
    ad_all = adata[:, used_in_model_final].copy()
    # Ensure layer counts remain int32 CSR and X float32
    if sp.issparse(ad_all.layers["counts"]):
        ad_all.layers["counts"] = ad_all.layers["counts"].tocsr().astype(np.int32)
    else:
        ad_all.layers["counts"] = sp.csr_matrix(ad_all.layers["counts"]).astype(np.int32)
    if sp.issparse(ad_all.X):
        ad_all.X = ad_all.X.tocsr().astype(np.float32)
    else:
        ad_all.X = ad_all.X.astype(np.float32)

    # Prepare splits: train/val/test (subset on split)
    adata_train = ad_all[ad_all.obs["split"] == "train"].copy()
    adata_val = ad_all[ad_all.obs["split"] == "val"].copy()
    adata_test = ad_all[ad_all.obs["split"] == "test"].copy()

    # Write outputs: all + splits (model genes only)
    ad_all.write_h5ad(OUT_ALL)
    adata_train.write_h5ad(OUT_TRAIN)
    adata_val.write_h5ad(OUT_VAL)
    adata_test.write_h5ad(OUT_TEST)

    # Mirror core preprocessed h5ad artifacts to step_1 directory for downstream compatibility
    try:
        for src in [OUT_ALL, OUT_TRAIN, OUT_VAL, OUT_TEST]:
            dst = src.replace("/step_0/", "/step_1/")

def standardize_symbol(symbol: str) -> str:

    s = str(symbol)
